sources.title: LoRA Explained: Stable Diffusion Fine-Tuning | Imagera AI
sources.snippet: TL;DR LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a technique for fine-tuning AI models by injecting small trainable matrices into existing layers instead of retraining all parameters. A Stable Diffusion checkpoint is 2-7GB; a LoRA is 10-200MB.
